  "sql": "SELECT p.category, count(r.id) AS refund_count FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.id = r.order_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY refund_count DESC LIMIT 1",
  "tables_used": ["refunds", "orders", "order_items", "products"],
  "rationale": "Join refunds to orders to get order context, then to order_items to link to products, then to products to access the category dimension. Count refund IDs grouped by category, sort descending by count, and limit to 1 to get the single category with the highest refund count."
